page.layout: One page of text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside the line "propatulo". The catchword "Atq;" sits at the lower right. The page number is at the top left and the running head at the top centre.

main_text.l: ras: siqué claro & sincero, non autem præstigiis
Iesuiticis cæcato animo ea intuens, omnem tu-
cum & fallaciam cernere queas. Quodsi, vt
spero, facis, non dubito, quin iã nunc ex iis, quæ
in quauis nostra probationis domo, ad erudien-
dos & iuxta normam Societatis instituendos no-
uitios iaciuntur, spiritualibus fundamentis in-
telligas: neminem prorsus huic esse religioni a-
ptum, nisi qui vel naturalé quandam, vel seruili
educatione acquisitam, vel stupore quodam a-
nimi arreptâ propensionē habeat ad hypocri-
sin & superstitionē: nempè qui manifestâ quâdam
oris pietate, vultusq; totius benignitate de-
votionem, quam vocant, sciat suam prodere in
propatulo, quã tamen Christus abscondere ius-
sit in cubiculo: quíve publicè orans, non aliter
ac Pharisæus ieiunans, faciem nouerit suam ex-
terminare: quæ cùm verissima sit hypocrisis, à
nostris tamen ædificatio appellatur & devotio. E-
quidem hoc esse Societatis nostræ fundamentū,
indies magis magisq; perspicio, atq; valdè etiâ
deploro: neq; prius animus conquiescet meus,
quàm ex his sordibus emersero. Tu verò si diu-
turnâ consuetudine quasi altera natura impedi-
tus, illud fortassis necdum vides, efficiam pro-
fectò, vt vel solo id tactu, sensuum omnium stu-
pidissimo illo quidem, sed sincerissimo, & qui
minimè depravari possit, cognoscas.
Fateor fanè, inquam, Paule, me ista nondum
videre: quare si tenebris me Iesuiticis circum-
fusum arbitraris, fac, si potes, tactu falsè [?], cuius-
modi ea sint, vt cognoscam.

page.notes: The marginal note at the left is partly faint; its reference "Matth. 6." is read as "Mat.6." and is doubtful. The reference mark for that note is not visible in the text, so it is placed beside the line it sits against. The word "falsè" in the second paragraph is doubtful. The page number "io" is read as the old form of "10". The catchword "Atq;" is at the lower right, on the line of the last full line.
